# NEW 2026-11-19 round 7 C1, the Trebizond line 1339-1350. Generated by gen_trebizond.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (oe_ml_monthly, gen_mainline_lock.py, line 7 tre).
oe_tre_monthly = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_now value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_tre_done }
        oe_tre_after = yes
    }
    else = {
        oe_tre_void_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_tre_void } }
            if = { limit = { oe_tre_st0 = yes } oe_tre_fallback = yes }
            if = { limit = { oe_tre_due_11 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.11 }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_tre_due_2 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.2 }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_tre_due_9 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.9 }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_tre_lapse = yes } oe_tre_end = { r = 6 } }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_ml_free = yes oe_tre_sched_ok = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_tre_pick value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 0 oe_tre_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_tre_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_tre_pick value = 1 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 0 oe_tre_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_tre_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_tre_pick value = 3 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 0 oe_tre_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_tre_ch_4 set_variable = { name = oe_tre_pick value = 4 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 0 oe_tre_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_tre_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_tre_pick value = 5 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 0 oe_tre_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_tre_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_tre_pick value = 6 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 0 oe_tre_open_7 = yes } random = { chance = oe_tre_ch_7 set_variable = { name = oe_tre_pick value = 7 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 0 oe_tre_open_8 = yes } random = { chance = oe_tre_ch_8 set_variable = { name = oe_tre_pick value = 8 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.1 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.3 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 4 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.4 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 5 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.5 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 6 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.6 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 7 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.7 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_pick = 8 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.8 }
                remove_variable = oe_tre_pick
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The line can no longer go on (design 3.2): record why.
oe_tre_void_check = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:TRE } } oe_tre_void_do = { r = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { c:TRE = { is_ai = no } } oe_tre_void_do = { r = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { c:TRE = { is_subject_of = c:BYZ } } oe_tre_void_do = { r = 5 } }
    else_if = { limit = { c:TRE = { is_subject = yes } } oe_tre_void_do = { r = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { owns = location:constantinople } } oe_tre_void_do = { r = 4 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_tre_st0 = yes var:oe_tre_now >= 61 } oe_tre_void_do = { r = 1 } }
}
oe_tre_void_do = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_void_r value = $r$ }
    set_global_variable = oe_tre_void
    oe_tre_log = yes
}
# BYZ scope. The line ends with result $r$ (see gen_trebizond.py).
oe_tre_end = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_result value = $r$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_st value = 7 }
    set_global_variable = oe_tre_done
}
# BYZ scope. A new stage $s$ begins this month.
oe_tre_stage_to = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_st value = $s$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_now value = oe_ml_month_now }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    oe_tre_log = yes
}
# Any scope. One line in the debug log.
oe_tre_log = { debug_log = "OE_TRE st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_tre_st_v')|0] inf=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_tre_inf_v')|0] result=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_tre_result_v')|0] void=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_tre_void_v')|0] fallback=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_tre_fb_v')|0]" }

# BYZ scope. Influence: 25 at first, +5 while the old alliance with Trebizond holds; changes clamped to 0-100.
oe_tre_inf_init = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tre_inf } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tre_inf value = 25 }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:TRE has_mutual_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:alliance target = c:TRE } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tre_inf add = 5 }
        }
    }
}
oe_tre_inf_add = {
    oe_tre_inf_init = yes
    change_variable = { name = oe_tre_inf add = $n$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_tre_inf min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# BYZ scope, stage 0. Basil's death when vanilla flavor_tre.3 did not come (design 3.2, fallbacks A and B).
oe_tre_fallback = {
    if = { limit = { character:tre_basil_komnenos ?= { is_alive = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_tre_bm value = var:oe_tre_now } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_tre_fb_a = yes }
        random = {
            chance = oe_tre_fb_a_ch
            kill_character = { target = character:tre_basil_komnenos }
            c:TRE = { set_new_ruler = character:tre_irene_palaiologos }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tre_fb value = 1 }
            oe_tre_log = yes
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_tre_fb_b = yes }
        c:TRE = { set_new_ruler = character:tre_irene_palaiologos }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tre_fb value = 2 }
        oe_tre_log = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .2: the boy John (later Alexios III), born at Trebizond on 5 October 1338, son of Basil and Irene of
# Trebizond, created in the empire (not in the 1337 setup). Before that date he is created as a newborn.
oe_tre_make_john = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_tre_john ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
        if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1338.11.1 }
            create_character = { first_name = name_john female = no dynasty = dynasty:komnenos_dynasty culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:trebizond father = character:tre_basil_komnenos mother = character:tre_irene_trebizond birth_date = 1338.10.5 save_scope_as = oe_tre_new }
        }
        else = { create_character = { first_name = name_john female = no dynasty = dynasty:komnenos_dynasty culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:trebizond father = character:tre_basil_komnenos mother = character:tre_irene_trebizond age = 0 save_scope_as = oe_tre_new } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tre_john value = scope:oe_tre_new }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .2: Irene's rival and the elder son go to Constantinople.
oe_tre_send_rivals = {
    character:tre_irene_trebizond ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:TRE is_ruler = no } move_country = c:BYZ } }
    character:tre_alexios_komnenos ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:TRE is_ruler = no } move_country = c:BYZ } }
}

# BYZ scope. .4: who wins in July 1341. oe_tre_e4 = 1 Anna (history), 2 Irene keeps the throne and marries Michael
# (only after .3 a, oe_tre_keep_ch), 3 no Anna to raise: the ruler stays.
oe_tre_e4_do = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_e4 value = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_suitor oe_tre_mich_ok = yes oe_tre_irene_rules = yes }
        random = { chance = oe_tre_keep_ch set_variable = { name = oe_tre_e4 value = 2 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_e4 = 1 NOT = { oe_tre_anna_ok = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_tre_e4 value = 3 } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tre_e4 = 2 }
        character:tre_michael_komnenos = { move_country = c:TRE marry_character_ignore_blocks = character:tre_irene_palaiologos }
        c:TRE = { set_new_ruler = character:tre_michael_komnenos }
        oe_tre_stage_to = { s = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tre_e4 = 1 }
        location:trebizond = { change_prosperity = prosperity_severe_penalty }
        character:tre_anna_anachoutlou = { if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:TRE } } move_country = c:TRE } }
        c:TRE = { set_new_ruler = character:tre_anna_anachoutlou }
        character:tre_irene_palaiologos ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:TRE is_ruler = no } move_country = c:BYZ reset_ruler_title = {} } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_suitor oe_tre_mich_ok = yes }
            character:tre_michael_komnenos = { move_country = c:TRE set_variable = oe_tre_captive }
        }
        oe_tre_stage_to = { s = 2 }
    }
    else = {
        location:trebizond = { change_prosperity = prosperity_severe_penalty }
        oe_tre_stage_to = { s = 3 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, hidden .91 (.5 a / b): John III goes home; certain after .5 a, oe_tre_succ_ch after .5 b.
oe_tre_91 = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tre_st ?= 2 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_tre_void } country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { is_ai = yes } character:tre_ioannes_iii_komnenos ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tre_ok91 value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_q91 ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tre_ok91 value = 1 } }
        else = { random = { chance = oe_tre_succ_ch set_variable = { name = oe_tre_ok91 value = 1 } } }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_tre_ok91 = 1 }
            character:tre_ioannes_iii_komnenos = { move_country = c:TRE }
            c:TRE = { set_new_ruler = character:tre_ioannes_iii_komnenos }
            if = { limit = { character:tre_anna_anachoutlou ?= { is_alive = yes } } character:tre_anna_anachoutlou = { save_scope_as = oe_tre_anna_x } kill_character = { target = scope:oe_tre_anna_x reason = execution } }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_pretender } remove_variable = oe_tre_pretender }
            oe_tre_stage_to = { s = 4 }
        }
        else = {
            oe_tre_inf_add = { n = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tre_pretender value = character:tre_ioannes_iii_komnenos }
            oe_tre_log = yes
        }
        remove_variable = oe_tre_ok91
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_q91 } remove_variable = oe_tre_q91 }
}

# BYZ scope, .6 immediate: Michael on the throne, John III to the empire.
oe_tre_6_do = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_e6 value = 2 }
    if = { limit = { character:tre_michael_komnenos ?= { owner ?= c:TRE } } set_variable = { name = oe_tre_e6 value = 1 } }
    character:tre_michael_komnenos = {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:TRE } } move_country = c:TRE }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_captive } remove_variable = oe_tre_captive }
    }
    c:TRE = { set_new_ruler = character:tre_michael_komnenos }
    character:tre_ioannes_iii_komnenos ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:TRE is_ruler = no } move_country = c:BYZ reset_ruler_title = {} } }
    oe_tre_stage_to = { s = 5 }
}

# BYZ scope, hidden .92 (.8 a / b / c): the new emperor goes home. oe_tre_q92 = 1 the prince (var:oe_tre_cv), 2 John III.
oe_tre_92 = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_tre_void }
            country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { is_ai = yes }
            OR = {
                AND = { var:oe_tre_q92 ?= 2 oe_tre_pret_ok = yes }
                AND = { var:oe_tre_q92 ?= 1 var:oe_tre_cv ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no } }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_tre_q92 = 2 }
            var:oe_tre_pretender = { save_scope_as = oe_tre_nr }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tre_installed value = 2 }
            remove_variable = oe_tre_pretender
        }
        else = {
            var:oe_tre_cv = { save_scope_as = oe_tre_nr }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tre_installed value = var:oe_tre_ck }
        }
        c:TRE = { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tre_or } }
        scope:oe_tre_nr = { if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:TRE } } move_country = c:TRE } }
        c:TRE = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_tre_nr }
        # The old ruler goes to Constantinople (history: Michael, deposed, in 1351); Anna would stay.
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_tre_or scope:oe_tre_or = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no owner ?= c:TRE NOT = { this = character:tre_anna_anachoutlou } } }
            scope:oe_tre_or = { move_country = c:BYZ reset_ruler_title = {} }
        }
        # The boy's mother goes home with him and is regent if the engine set up a regency.
        character:tre_irene_trebizond ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { owner ?= c:TRE } } move_country = c:TRE } }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_tre_nr = { is_adult = no } c:TRE = { has_regent = yes } character:tre_irene_trebizond ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:TRE } }
            c:TRE = { set_regent = character:tre_irene_trebizond }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tre_alx value = scope:oe_tre_nr }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_q92_bride var:oe_tre_q92 = 1 } oe_tre_make_bride = yes }
        oe_tre_stage_to = { s = 6 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tre.9 days = 30 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_tre_void } } oe_tre_end = { r = 6 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_q92 } remove_variable = oe_tre_q92 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_q92_bride } remove_variable = oe_tre_q92_bride }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_tre_nr = the young emperor. .8 a: a bride of the imperial family, betrothed to him (Theodora
# Kantakouzene while John VI reigns; otherwise a girl of the reigning dynasty), about 10 years old.
oe_tre_make_bride = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_tre_kant_rules = yes }
        create_character = { first_name = name_theodora dynasty = dynasty:kantakouzenos_dynasty female = yes culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:constantinople age = 10 save_scope_as = oe_tre_bride_s }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes } }
        create_character = { dynasty = c:BYZ.ruler.dynasty female = yes culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:constantinople age = 10 save_scope_as = oe_tre_bride_s }
    }
    else = { create_character = { female = yes culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:constantinople age = 10 save_scope_as = oe_tre_bride_s } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_bride value = scope:oe_tre_bride_s }
    scope:oe_tre_bride_s = { create_betrothal = scope:oe_tre_nr }
}

# BYZ scope. Kin and alliance (.9 b, or .9 a refused): opinion, our modifier, an alliance if there is none, and the
# promise of a dignity when the young emperor comes of age.
oe_tre_kin_fx = {
    c:TRE ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tre_kin target = c:BYZ } }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tre_kinship years = 10 mode = replace }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { is_subject = no } NOT = { has_mutual_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:alliance target = c:TRE } } }
        create_relation = { first = c:BYZ second = c:TRE type = relation_type:alliance }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_alx ?= { is_adult = no } } set_variable = oe_tre_promise }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_result value = 2 }
}
# BYZ scope. Clears var:oe_tw_grant_target if it is Trebizond (the line set it).
oe_tre_tw_clear = { if = { limit = { var:oe_tw_grant_target ?= { tag = TRE } } remove_variable = oe_tw_grant_target } }
# BYZ scope. Confers the highest dignity open (Despot, else Protosebastos) through the dignity system.
oe_tre_tw_grant = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_grant_target } country_exists = c:TRE } set_variable = { name = oe_tw_grant_target value = c:TRE } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_tw_grant_target ?= { tag = TRE } oe_tw_can_grant_despotes = yes } oe_tw_grant_despotes = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tw_grant_target ?= { tag = TRE } oe_tw_can_grant_protosebastos = yes } oe_tw_grant_protosebastos = yes }
    oe_tre_tw_clear = yes
}
# BYZ scope, hidden .93: .9's outcome. oe_tre_q93 = 1 tributary (rolled), 2 kin, 3 a dignity.
oe_tre_93 = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tre_q93 ?= 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { is_subject = no } }
            random = { chance = oe_tre_trib_ch set_variable = oe_tre_trib_yes }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_trib_yes }
            c:TRE = { make_subject_of = { target = c:BYZ type = subject_type:tributary } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tre_result value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            c:TRE ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tre_snub target = c:BYZ } }
            oe_tre_kin_fx = yes
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_trib_yes } remove_variable = oe_tre_trib_yes }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_q93 ?= 2 } oe_tre_kin_fx = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tre_q93 ?= 3 }
        oe_tre_tw_grant = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_tre_result value = 3 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_q93 } remove_variable = oe_tre_q93 }
    oe_tre_log = yes
}
# BYZ scope, hidden .94: .10's dignity. oe_tre_q94 = 1 Despot, 2 Protosebastos.
oe_tre_94 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_grant_target } country_exists = c:TRE } set_variable = { name = oe_tw_grant_target value = c:TRE } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_q94 ?= 1 var:oe_tw_grant_target ?= { tag = TRE } oe_tw_can_grant_despotes = yes } oe_tw_grant_despotes = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_q94 ?= 2 var:oe_tw_grant_target ?= { tag = TRE } oe_tw_can_grant_protosebastos = yes } oe_tw_grant_protosebastos = yes }
    oe_tre_tw_clear = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_q94 } remove_variable = oe_tre_q94 }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly after the end: the wedding (.8 a) and the promised dignity (.10).
oe_tre_after = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_bride }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_tre_wed_ok = yes }
            var:oe_tre_bride = { save_scope_as = oe_tre_wb }
            var:oe_tre_alx = { save_scope_as = oe_tre_wg }
            scope:oe_tre_wb = { marry_character_ignore_blocks = scope:oe_tre_wg move_country = c:TRE }
            remove_variable = oe_tre_bride
            set_variable = oe_tre_wed
            oe_tre_log = yes
        }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_tre_wed_off = yes } remove_variable = oe_tre_bride }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_promise NOT = { oe_tre_alx_rules = yes } }
        remove_variable = oe_tre_promise
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_tre_pre_10 = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tw_grant_target value = c:TRE }
        if = { limit = { oe_tre_tw_ok = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.10 }
        else = { remove_variable = oe_tw_grant_target }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- test page (DEV_LINES in gen_trebizond.py), BYZ scope
# Basil dies and Irene takes the throne of Trebizond (Trebizond must be run by the AI); .2 follows.
oe_tre_test_start = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_now value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { is_ai = yes } oe_tre_irene_alive = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_tre_basil_rules = yes } kill_character = { target = character:tre_basil_komnenos } }
        character:tre_irene_palaiologos = { if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:TRE } } move_country = c:TRE } }
        c:TRE = { set_new_ruler = character:tre_irene_palaiologos }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tre.2 days = 1 }
    }
}
# The next event of the line at once, without windows and lock (event triggers still apply).
oe_tre_test_next = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_now value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_tre_done has_variable = oe_tre_promise }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_grant_target } country_exists = c:TRE } set_variable = { name = oe_tw_grant_target value = c:TRE } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.10
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_tre_done } oe_tre_log = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_tre_st0 = yes oe_tre_due_11 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.11 }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_tre_st0 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_tre_done_1 } oe_tre_basil_rules = yes oe_tre_married = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.1 }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_tre_st0 = yes oe_tre_irene_rules = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.2 }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_tre_st0 = yes } oe_tre_test_start = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_st ?= 1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_tre_done_3 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.3 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_st ?= 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.4 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_st ?= 2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_tre_done_5 } oe_tre_j3_ok = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.5 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_st ?= 4 NOT = { has_variable = oe_tre_done_6 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.6 }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_tre_st15 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_tre_done_7 } country_exists = c:GEN } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.7 }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_tre_st15 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.8 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tre_st ?= 6 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.9 }
}
# Influence +20.
oe_tre_test_inf = { oe_tre_inf_add = { n = 20 } oe_tre_log = yes }
# Straight to 1349: the prince goes home (.8); a boy of 11 is created when there is no candidate.
oe_tre_test_1349 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tre_now value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { is_ai = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_tre_cand_any = yes } }
            create_character = { first_name = name_john female = no dynasty = dynasty:komnenos_dynasty culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:trebizond father = character:tre_basil_komnenos mother = character:tre_irene_trebizond age = 11 save_scope_as = oe_tre_new }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tre_john value = scope:oe_tre_new }
        }
        oe_tre_inf_init = yes
        set_global_variable = oe_tre_begun
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_tre_done } remove_global_variable = oe_tre_done }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_tre_void } remove_global_variable = oe_tre_void }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_tre_st15 = yes } } oe_tre_stage_to = { s = 5 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_done_8 } remove_variable = oe_tre_done_8 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_result } remove_variable = oe_tre_result } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tre_void_r } remove_variable = oe_tre_void_r }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tre.8
    }
}
